summary: Verification pass on the Inbound STO Receipt page (/inventory/inbound-receipts) with its new 'Completed Receipts' tab. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_inbound_receipts_completed_iter137.py (10 tests, 8 passed, 1 skipped, 1 failed) covering /api/inbound-receipts/completed (shape, sort, site filter, date range, empty cases) plus pending/sites regression. Frontend: full Playwright pass with the synthetic vms_session cookie - page loads clean (no console errors, no error overlay), both tabs switch correctly, Pending tab (34 rows) expand/collapse, receive dialog with editable + validated quantities, checkbox select / select-all / bulk bar / bulk confirm dialog all work (no SAP-writing confirm was ever clicked), Completed tab renders 18 real rows with status badges, site filter (P1 -> 7 rows) and Clear-dates work, tab switching preserves filter state. TWO REAL DEFECTS FOUND: (1) the date-range filter returns ZERO rows for any date because receipt_completed_at is null on all 18 existing records, and (2) the 'Time Taken' column is '—' on 100% of rows - i.e. the two headline features of the new tab are non-functional against existing data.

critical.issue: Date filter queries on `receipt_completed_at`, which is null/absent on ALL 18 existing completed STOs (only newly-finalized receipts get it). Repro: date_from=2020-01-01 -> orders=[] although the unfiltered call returns 18 rows. Any date filter the user sets therefore always yields an empty table. Fix: filter on `receipt_completed_at` with a fallback to `received_at`/`receipt_started_at` (e.g. $or on both fields), or backfill receipt_completed_at from received_at.

`receipt_duration_seconds` is null for 18/18 rows, so the 'Time Taken to complete receipt in SAP' column (the user's explicit ask for this tab) shows '—' everywhere. Code that stamps it (inbound_receipt_service.finalize_receipt) is correct, but nothing is backfilled and no completed record in the DB has it. Consider deriving from receipt_started_at/received_at where available, or seeding a live receipt so the column is demonstrably populated.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 (unhandled datetime.fromisoformat ValueError at server.py ~5504). Should be 400/422.
Sorted by receipt_completed_at which is null on every row, so ordering is effectively arbitrary (currently ascending STO id: STO-000018 first) - 'newest receipt first' is not achieved.
No auth/session check in the endpoint handlers (unlike /receive which resolves the user); data is readable with any/no session. Only the frontend route is protected.

ui_bugs.issue: All 18 rows show '—' (backend data gap above); the column adds no value today
Shows '—' for every partial/failed row (8/18) because it only falls back received_at -> receipt_completed_at, both null for those. Users can't tell when the attempt happened.

Raw SAP OData JSON leaks to the UI for legacy rows, e.g. STO-000018: 'P8D1-173: HTTP 500: {"error":{"code":"ERROR","message":...'. _humanize_sap_error only runs at finalize time, so stored legacy receipt_error strings render verbatim (same class of issue reported in iteration_134). Humanize on read in list_completed_receipts.

integration_issues.issue: Setting From=2020-01-01 (a range that covers everything) empties the table and shows the empty state, instead of listing all 18 receipts. API call fired correctly (?date_from=2020-01-01) - server returns []. User-visible break of the new filter.

issues: From/To use the native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy with browser picker) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere - inconsistent with the app's design system
Date inputs are US-format while all dates in the tables render as en-IN (28 Aug 2026) - mixed formats

action_items: Make the Completed tab date filter work on existing data: filter on receipt_completed_at OR received_at (or backfill receipt_completed_at from received_at). Currently every date filter returns zero rows.
Populate/derive receipt_duration_seconds (and a completed timestamp) for existing records so the 'Time Taken' column is not '—' on 100% of rows.
Show a timestamp for partial/failed rows in 'Received At' (fall back to receipt_started_at).
Run _humanize_sap_error when reading completed receipts so legacy raw JSON SAP faults don't render in the table.
Return 400/422 instead of 500 for malformed date_from/date_to on /api/inbound-receipts/completed.
Optionally replace native date inputs with the shadcn Calendar for design consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: inbound_receipt_service.list_completed_receipts: querying/sorting on a field (receipt_completed_at) that no historical document has silently breaks the filter; add a $or fallback on received_at.
server.py ~5502: datetime.fromisoformat(date_from) is unguarded -> 500 on bad input; wrap in try/except and raise HTTPException(400). Also prefer FastAPI date type params.
/api/inbound-receipts/completed & /pending do not resolve the session user at all - inconsistent with /receive which does; consider requiring auth server-side.
server.py is very large (>5500 lines) - the inbound-receipt routes would be better in their own router module.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (all interactions pass; date filter + Time Taken column non-functional)

rca_of_the_issue: The new Completed tab was built around two new fields (receipt_completed_at, receipt_duration_seconds) that are only written by finalize_receipt going forward. No existing STO document has them, and the Mongo query `{'receipt_completed_at': {'$gte': ...}}` excludes documents where the field is absent - so any date filter matches nothing and the sort is a no-op. Repro: open /inventory/inbound-receipts -> Completed (18 rows, all Time Taken '—') -> set From=2020-01-01 -> table empties to 'No completed receipts found for this filter.'
